text:
maria_sec: Heads-up: seeing a spike of mTLS enrollment failures in ap-south starting ~02:10 UTC after the rotator rollout.

ben_sre: Confirmed. Prod proxy telemetry shows lots of peer verification errors + cert not present. Example log: 
```
2025-02-12T02:12:01Z cert-rotator ERROR enroll failed: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: kms:GenerateDataKey	status=403
stack=rotator/enroll.go:88
instance=proxy-78a request_id=ef12-9a34
```

tom_rotator: That was my last PR. I tightened the rotator role yesterday to remove "kms:GenerateDataKey" because I thought we only needed Decrypt for keys. I didn't realize the CSR envelope uses GenerateDataKey during storage. My bad.

xiao_infra: That would break enrollments. GenerateDataKey is used by the envelope flow to create the encrypted blob for the cert material before writing to object store. Without it, rotator can't persist new certs.

maria_sec: Impact: new cert issuance fails -> existing kube-proxies keep serving old certs but renewals fail. We need audit + incident steps.

ben_sre: Quick mitigation: roll back the RBAC change to restore previous permissions for rotator-service, then sweep failed enrollments. Danger: wide-granting GenerateDataKey is sensitive. We should grant to the specific KMS key ARN + add conditions (SourceVPC + PrincipalTag).

maria_sec: Also we need to capture decrypt/generate attempts in audit pipeline for triage. Include principal_arn, principal_tags, source_region, request_id, and cert_fingerprint in logs. Sampling = 100% for affected region for 48h.

audit-bot: ack. Configuring sink: secure-audit.sinks.rotator-errors -> retention=14d, alert_on=KMS:GenerateDataKey:AccessDenied count>50 in 10m. Ticket auto-create to INC-rotator-kms-2025-02-12.

ben_sre: Proposed emergency policy snippet (narrow): 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey", "kms:Decrypt"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:123456:key/rotator-key-2024",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/Service": "cert-rotator"},
        "IpAddress": {"aws:SourceIp": ["10.0.0.0/8"]}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
This scopes to the rotator key + principal tag + internal IP ranges. We can tighten further later.

tom_rotator: I'll open the rollback PR now to restore the previous role and include the scoped policy above.

xiao_infra: After rollback, run re-enroll for the last 2 hours of failures. Use the replay tool: 
```bash
./replay-enroll --cluster prod --since 2h --filter enroll_failed --concurrency 20
```
That will attempt issuance again; we should watch for duplicate serials.

maria_sec: Incident response thresholds: abort rotation / rollback if enrollment_failure_rate > 0.5% of successful handshakes over a 10m window in any region. Oncall notify to @eng-oncall and @eng-security.

ben_sre: Add synthetic mTLS probe across regions (eu-west, ap-south, us-east) that attempts a full TLS handshake and certificate verification every 30s. Probe will post metrics to keystore.mtls_probe. Alert if <95% success over 5m.

audit-bot: synthetic-probe-hooked: metric=keystore.mtls_probe.success_rate; threshold=0.95; window=5m; notify=@eng-oncall,@eng-security; runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/m_tls_probe

maria_sec: Also: vuln triage note 1: We discovered rotator code logs cert serials in debug mode in rare paths. Ensure PII removal and toggle debug off in prod.

xiao_infra: Good catch. We'll flip the config and rotate access logs for the window. Also ensure S3 object ACLs are correct for the reprovisioned certs.

tom_rotator: Action items (WIP):
- rollback RBAC for rotator (PR -> merge within 15m) @tom_rotator
- apply narrow GenerateDataKey policy with PrincipalTag and IP condition @ben_sre (15m)
- run replay-enroll on failed list @xiao_infra (30m)
- enable audit sink + saved ELK query for request_id correlation @maria_sec (now)
- disable debug cert serial logging in rotator config @tom_rotator (10m)

ben_sre: I'll post the PR link when ready and follow-up with the ELK saved query.

maria_sec: If rollback incomplete after 30m, escalate to oncall and open an incident bridge.

xiao_infra: Joining a quick triage call in 5. link: https://meet.redwood.internal/rotator-kms-triage

ben_sre: joining.

tom_rotator: joining.

maria_sec: thanks team, keep updates in thread.
